name: knowyouragenticai-receipts
summary: The evidence layer that sits under an agent platform. A platform decides what an agent may do; this records what it tried and was refused, sealed so the other side can check it without trusting whoever ran the agent. Every attempt is a receipt, refusals included, and each seals onto the last. Verifiable in a browser with nothing installed. Native MCP server included. Zero dependencies. Free and MIT licensed; assurance for production agents at https://rumedominic.com/assurance
author: Rume Dominic (O'Rume Dominic Uririe)
